verdict.rationale: The products page says it offers "Transparent fees" and "Flat, scoped pricing with what's included", and contrasts its model with billable hours. But no actual dollar amounts, published flat fees, or priced service menu appear anywhere in the evidence. A founder could not see real prices before contacting the firm. Describing the pricing model is related to the story but is not the same as publishing prices.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see real prices before I talk to anyone — published flat fees or a priced service menu on the provider's own site
